plugins.name: claude-telegram-voice
plugins.description: Automatic voice message transcription for the Telegram channel plugin. When a voice message arrives, Claude downloads and transcribes it using a user-supplied command (Whisper, faster-whisper, OpenAI API, etc.).

skills.name: voice-transcription
skills.description: Automatically transcribe Telegram voice messages. Activates when an inbound Telegram message has attachment_kind="voice". Downloads the voice file and transcribes it so the user's spoken words are understood.
skills.description_zh: 在收到attachment_kind为voice的Telegram消息时下载语音并自动转写，以理解用户口述内容。
